sections.value:
PASS WITH NOTES — performance/263, round 1, exact head 2b0ce696554bd03a023193a584f916a904a160e9.

No blocking performance finding. Detached HEAD matched the requested SHA; the exact-head merge-base diff touches nine files and no launch inventory, dependency, extension, timer or scheduling code.

Cost contract (source review / inferential):
| Changed path | Added launches/s | Trigger / interval | Scaling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NativeHandoff ancestry retention and carried-route decision | 0 | Existing native registration; route lookup only under !same_launch; no new poll/timer | Existing vector moved, not cloned; host removal and exact-identity lookup each bounded by the existing 32-process ancestry cap (at most 31 ancestors). No per-tick/per-seat work. One fixed reason String for a successful carry. |

Evidence: crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:613-662 reuses verify_native_host's result, :746-803 retains the already-allocated/verified vector, and :1191-1225 consults it without another observation, spawn or await. The existing loop bound and five-second observation timeout are unchanged. CacheProxy notice/doctor classification receives the same proxied enum, without an additional polling path. Workstream 004 s08's no-launch description and blueprint 003 are consistent with this delta.

Important distinction: native registration is NOT wholly launch-free on macOS. Existing native_observer / AncestryReads (:2067-2105, :2224-2309) reads parent/name in-process and caches one absolute-path /bin/ps argv read per host-named ancestor. This PR adds zero such calls and changes neither the walk nor its trigger rate. Linux's existing /proc path remains launch-free. The only route membership scan is in-memory.

Live-before receipt: 2026-11-19T07:43:47.306322Z–07:44:07.555743Z, monotonic interval 20.249 s. Both ping readings identify daemon PID 36530, running commit a70cace40b (not the reviewed patch). Total spawns stayed 2582; every by_op delta was zero, including ps.registration-native-process at 931. The embedded spawn-rate receipt is the simultaneous 20-second whole-machine sample; attribution is a lower bound, not an exact daemon count. Resource snapshot is embedded separately; ps %CPU is a snapshot, not an interval CPU benchmark.

Checks exercised: live ping twice; just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json; /bin/ps PID/CPU/RSS; exact-head diff; git diff --exit-code origin/main...<head> -- crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs returned 0/no diff. No builds, cargo, shared-build, tests or daemon restart performed, as required for this review seat. This is not a runtime proof of the patch.

Note owed by the live-proof owner: repeat counters, whole-machine spawn rate and daemon CPU/RSS after deployment while exercising the Copilot restart path; confirm zero added launch sites/calls. Current baseline alone cannot establish that after result.

Harness feedback / magicWand: a single spawn-rate receipt that brackets itself with ping counters, same-daemon identity and CPU/RSS would encode the manual pairing. Difficulties: no blocking tooling issue; the distinction between zero incremental launches and the pre-existing host argv ps calls must remain explicit.
